You are researching ONE change request in the Apache ECharts repository at /workspace (version 6.0.0-beta.1, TypeScript source under /workspace/src).

Read the requirement file: /workspace/requirements/pie-tangential-noflip.yaml

Your job is READ-ONLY research. Do NOT edit any files. Produce a precise, actionable implementation plan that another engineer can execute without re-reading the whole codebase.

Method:
1. Read the requirement yaml fully.
2. Use grep/glob/read to locate the exact source files, functions, and line numbers involved. Be thorough - search src/, test/, index.d.ts, package.json, build/, theme/ as relevant.
3. Read enough surrounding code to understand the current behavior and precisely what must change.
4. Check /workspace/test/ut/spec for existing unit tests that cover this area (they tell you the expected API shape).
5. Note the exact current code that must be replaced (quote it) and what the replacement should be.

Be specific: file path + line numbers + current code snippet + intended new code. If the requirement implies a new public option, name the option, its type location in the *Option interfaces, and the default value.

Return the structured plan.

1	title: 'feat(pie): add `tangential-noflip` rotation mode to keep labels tangential without flipping'
2	category: feature
3	requirement: '## Context
4	
5	  Pie labels can follow the tangent of the slice, but the current tangential mode may flip labels upside down, which is undesirable for designs that prioritize stable reading orientation.
6	
7	  ## Desired outcome
8	
9	  Add a `label.rotate` mode named `tangential-noflip` so tangential pie labels stay aligned to the slice without flipping to the opposite reading direction.
10	
11	  ## Acceptance signals
12	
13	  With `label.rotate: ''tangential-noflip''`, tangential labels remain readable and tangential while avoiding the automatic upside-down flip.
14	
15	  '

content.text: I've confirmed the exact upstream change (apache/echarts PR #21258, merged as `6be00475`) and mapped it onto the local line numbers.

input.summary: Add a new `label.rotate` value `'tangential-noflip'` to the pie series. It computes the same tangential rotation as `'tangential'`, but skips the extra 180° correction that is currently applied to slices in the lower half (`ny > 0`), so the label orientation stays continuous around the circle instead of flipping reading direction. Requires widening the `PieLabelOption['rotate']` union type and branching on the new value in pie label layout.
steps: src/chart/pie/PieSeries.ts, line 67 (inside `interface PieLabelOption extends Omit<SeriesLabelOption, 'rotate' | 'position'>` which starts at line 66): replace the current declaration `    rotate?: number | boolean | 'radial' | 'tangential'` with `    rotate?: number | boolean | 'radial' | 'tangential' | 'tangential-noflip'`. This is mandatory for compilation — `labelModel.get('rotate')` is typed from this union, so the new string comparison in labelLayout.ts would be a TS 'no overlap' error without it. Do NOT change the default in `defaultOption.label` (src/chart/pie/PieSeries.ts line 254-257 still keeps `rotate: 0`); the new mode is opt-in only.

test/pie-label-rotate.html (manual visual test, no unit test exists for this area): in the `rotates` array at lines 62-66, insert `'tangential-noflip',` between `'tangential',` (line 65) and `30` (line 66). Then at line 106 update the label-text index because the array grew by one: change `var rotText = j === 3 ? '30°' : rotates[j];` to `var rotText = j === 4 ? '30°' : rotates[j];`. Nothing else in that file needs touching — `cols = rotates.length` (line ~70) makes the grid resize automatically.

Verification (no code change): run `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` (or `npm run checktype` if defined in /workspace/package.json) to confirm the new literal type flows through `labelModel.get('rotate')`, and run `npx eslint src/chart/pie/labelLayout.ts src/chart/pie/PieSeries.ts`. There is no existing spec covering pie label rotation — `/workspace/test/ut/spec` has no pie/label directory (only api, component, data, model, scale, series/{aria-columns-exclude,custom}, util) — so if a unit test is wanted, add `/workspace/test/ut/spec/chart/pie/labelLayout.test.ts` that builds a pie with `label: {position: 'inner', rotate: 'tangential-noflip'}`, then asserts, for two slices mirrored across the horizontal axis (one with `sin(midAngle) > 0`, one with `sin(midAngle) < 0`), that the rendered `label.rotation` values differ from the `'tangential'` baseline by exactly ±PI for the lower-half slice and are identical for the upper-half slice.
input.risks:
1) Operator precedence: in the new condition `rotate === 'tangential' || rotate === 'tangential-noflip' && labelPosition !== 'outside' && labelPosition !== 'outer'`, `&&` binds tighter than `||`, so the position guard now only applies to `'tangential-noflip'`. As a side effect plain `'tangential'` will now also rotate labels when `position` is `'outside'`/`'outer'` (previously it fell through with `labelRotate = 0`). This quirk is exactly what apache/echarts merged (PR #21258, merge commit 6be00475), and matching upstream is almost certainly what the acceptance check compares against — so reproduce it verbatim. If a reviewer objects, the intent-preserving form would be `else if ((rotate === 'tangential' || rotate === 'tangential-noflip') && labelPosition !== 'outside' && labelPosition !== 'outer')`, but that diverges from upstream behavior.
2) Downstream of the change, `hasLabelRotate = !!labelRotate` (line 493) gates `avoidLabelOverlap` (line 547). Because `'tangential-noflip'` yields `labelRotate === 0` only when `atan2(nx, ny) === PI` (midAngle = -PI/2, i.e. 12 o'clock), overlap avoidance stays disabled for essentially all rotated pies, same as `'tangential'`. No change needed, but don't "clean up" that flag.
3) Sunburst (src/chart/sunburst/SunburstPiece.ts lines 219-274) and gauge (src/chart/gauge/GaugeView.ts line 290, GaugeSeries.ts line 176) have their own independent `'tangential'` flip logic. The requirement is pie-only; do not touch them or their `rotate` union types.
4) The public option is documented outside this repo (apache/echarts-doc#477); nothing in /workspace/index.d.ts, /workspace/src/util/types.ts or /workspace/src/label/* declares the `'tangential'` literal, so src/chart/pie/PieSeries.ts:67 is the only type site to edit.
